关键词: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
主要内容: The U.S. Department of the Treasury has issued a call for Large Position Reports from entities holding positions in the 2-1/4% Treasury Notes of November 2027. Entities with positions equal to or exceeding $4.58 billion as of January 12, 2018, are required to report these positions to the Federal Reserve Bank of New York. Reports must be submitted by 12:00 PM Eastern Time on April 16, 2018. The reporting threshold is $4.58 billion in par value, and the maturity date of the notes is November 15, 2027. The call for reports is based on Treasury's large position reporting rules (17 CFR Part 420).

股票实体.名称: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
